phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Commercial and home-use hydroponic systems primarily consist of modular recirculating systems with channels or trays that hold plants without soil, combined with integrated water-nutrient delivery and support structures designed for optimized space utilization and plant growth control.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The most common hydroponic systems in agriculture and consumer markets today utilize recirculating nutrient film technique (NFT) or deep water culture (DWC) styles with standardized modular trays, reservoirs, and structural frames. These systems have gained widespread adoption due to scalability, improved plant yield, and efficient resource management.
